verdict.rationale: Stripe provides generic building blocks that could support this (webhooks for event-driven automation, a Disputes API/Dashboard with Smart Disputes automated evidence collection, and an official MCP server letting AI agents call the Stripe API), but none of the evidence ties these together into a documented workflow of an agent monitoring dispute deadlines and drafting evidence for human review specifically in a Terminal (card-present) context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of agent/MCP use for dispute deadline tracking, evidence drafting for review (vs. full automation), and confirmation this applies to Terminal-specific in-person disputes rather than generic Stripe disputes.
